# Install

Install with HACS, then restart Home Assistant.

## Install with HACS

1. Open the HACS repository link: `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=belikh&repository=ha-lg-webos-tv&category=integration`. Choose **Download**. You can also search for **LG WebOS TV (bscpylgtv)** in HACS.
2. Restart Home Assistant.

If the search finds nothing, add the repository by hand:

1. In HACS, open the three-dot menu at the top right and choose **Custom repositories**.
2. Enter `https://github.com/belikh/ha-lg-webos-tv` with category **Integration**.
3. Install the integration and restart Home Assistant.

## Install by hand

1. Copy the `custom_components/bscpylgtv` folder from the repository into the `custom_components` directory of your Home Assistant configuration.
2. Restart Home Assistant.

**Resulting layout**

```text
<config>/custom_components/bscpylgtv/manifest.json
```

**See also**

- [Set up a TV](set-up.md)
